details:
HOME BEYOND EARTH

Home Beyond Earth is an interactive space mission-planning simulation that introduces players to the challenges of preparing for planetary exploration and considering the possibility of establishing a future home beyond Earth.

Players take on the role of a junior astronaut working alongside a crew to prepare for an exploration mission. Throughout the experience, they make decisions about essential mission equipment, including antennas, scanners and solar panels, while managing limited resources such as budget, mass and power.

The project also introduces planetary exploration through scanning activities, allowing players to examine different terrain features and consider their potential for future exploration and settlement.

Developed using RouteVN Creator, the project combines visual storytelling, interactive choices and simplified mission-planning mechanics to make space exploration more engaging and accessible.

Its educational purpose is to help players understand that planning a space mission involves more than exploration. It also requires resource management, teamwork, decision-making and careful consideration of the environment.

Home Beyond Earth aims to encourage curiosity about space exploration and inspire players to imagine the possibilities of humanity's future beyond Earth.

Current Version: 0.1.0 (Playable Demo)
